categories.main_business_segments: Infac Corporation specializes in manufacturing automotive parts including actuators, solenoid valves, mechanical cables, electronic parking brake (EPB) cables, control cables, and power electronics PCB assemblies. The company focuses on eco-friendly, electrified, and modular automotive components, serving both domestic and global OEMs. It operates through multiple subsidiaries domestically and internationally, producing a broad range of automotive components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies for automotive actuators, solenoid valves, and electronic components such as power electronics PCB assemblies. It emphasizes research and development in electrification components, including motor actuators, air spring valves, and battery charging converters. Production methods include cable assembly, valve manufacturing, and integration of electronic control units, supported by global sourcing and cost reduction efforts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Infac serves major domestic automotive manufacturers like Hyundai, Kia, Hyundai Mobis, and KG Mobility, as well as global OEMs including GM, Mazda, BorgWarner, AMK, Brembo, and Vibracoustic. Its products are supplied to both complete vehicle manufacturers and module suppliers, targeting markets for internal combustion engine vehicles and rapidly growing eco-friendly electric vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with significant overseas presence through subsidiaries in China, India, Mexico, North America, Vietnam, and Poland. It has established production and sales operations globally to serve international automotive markets, including Europe and North America, reflecting a global footprint in automotive parts manufacturing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Infac operates primarily as an upstream and midstream supplier in the automotive supply chain, manufacturing key components such as actuators, cables, valves, and electronic assemblies for OEMs and module suppliers. It is positioned as a Tier 1 or Tier 2 supplier providing essential parts directly to vehicle manufacturers and their module assemblers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in eco-friendly and electrified automotive components, focusing on next-generation motor actuators, power electronics, electronic parking brakes, and air suspension valves. It invests in advanced technologies like heavy copper inlay PCB assemblies and high-capacity DC/DC converters for rapid battery charging. The R&D organization is structured with specialized teams for shaft design, power electronics, battery, and electronic control systems to support innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Infac generates revenue primarily through the sale of automotive parts and components under OEM contracts. Sales include both domestic and export transactions, with long-term supply agreements with major automakers. Revenue streams come from product sales of cables, actuators, valves, and electronic assemblies, supplemented by aftermarket and A/S parts sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Infac is positioned as a mid-sized, specialized automotive parts manufacturer competing in the global automotive supply market. It holds a competitive position by focusing on eco-friendly and electrified vehicle components and expanding its global production footprint to meet OEM demands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2023, Infac reported consolidated revenues of approximately 542.9 billion KRW, reflecting a 6.0% increase year-over-year. The company has shown steady growth supported by new overseas subsidiaries and increased demand for eco-friendly automotive parts. Total assets reached about 482.9 billion KRW with a 17.4% increase, and operating income rose by 13.0% to 23.5 billion KRW, indicating improving profitability despite increased financial costs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Infac emphasizes its expertise in eco-friendly and electrified automotive components, offering diversified products such as power electronics PCB assemblies and advanced actuators tailored for next-generation vehicles. Its value proposition includes technological innovation, global supply chain integration, cost competitiveness through global sourcing, and strong OEM relationships, enabling it to meet evolving automotive industry demands.
